name: Honda Shuuichi
source:
Aside from having a beautiful wife, he is an entirely ordinary salaryman.

He works in the Sales Department's Sales Promotion Section as a senior staff member, and enjoys the trust and respect of his subordinates.

He has very few hobbies to speak of and was previously the kind of man who devoted himself entirely to his work. However, ever since meeting his wife, Nanami, he has gradually come to place greater importance on his private life as well.

He has always been shy and inexperienced when it comes to women, even during his student days. Before marrying Nanami, he had only ever dated one woman. His lack of romantic and sexual experience is a source of insecurity for him. (His first girlfriend and he never even progressed to a physical relationship.)

He loves and cherishes Nanami more than anyone else, but he feels that she is a wife far beyond what he deserves. This leaves him plagued by an indescribable sense of insecurity.

He is extremely nearsighted and normally wears glasses with very strong prescription lenses.

He doesn't dislike watching or participating in sports, but wearing glasses is an obstacle, so he rarely takes the initiative to participate.

He loves animals, particularly cats, but has given up on owning one because of his severe cat allergy.

His workplace is four train stations away from his home, and he normally commutes by train. However, when he has to work on a day off, he sometimes drives there instead.

He basically has a five-day workweek, with Saturdays and Sundays off, although he frequently has to come in to work on Saturdays. (His annual income is approximately 7 million yen.)

He drinks alcohol in moderation and does not smoke at all.

As for his married sex life, they generally have sex on Saturday nights, the evening before their day off, depending on the mood that night. There are also nights when they don't, particularly if they are tired.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
